meta.title: Growth & Output
meta.blurb: GDP, industrial production, sentiment, leading indicators.

uk_gdp.name: UK Real GDP
uk_gdp.note: ONS quarterly chained-volume GDP. Uses the first estimate when current and the revised UK Economic Accounts series otherwise.

uk_gdp_yoy.name: UK GDP Growth YoY
uk_gdp_yoy.note: Calculated from the current ONS first-estimate or revised UK Economic Accounts quarterly GDP series.

uk_gdp_monthly.name: UK Monthly GDP Growth
uk_gdp_monthly.note: ONS monthly GDP, chained volume measure, seasonally adjusted; change on previous month.

uk_retail.name: UK Retail Sales Volume
uk_retail.note: ONS retail sales volume including fuel, seasonally adjusted.

us_leading.name: Chicago Fed Activity Index
us_leading.note: National Activity Index; replaces the discontinued US Leading Index, which ended in 2020.
